cues.headline: GOAL! Goran Dunmore!
cues.body: Ashvale Town score! It's Harbor City 0–1 Ashvale Town.

cues.headline: Ashvale Town are on top
cues.body: Ashvale Town are on top: winning the ball back in the opposition half 3 times, playing 9 progressive passes and forcing Harbor City into 3 losses in their own half in the last 5 minutes. Ashvale Town are already ahead, and still pushing.

cues.headline: Niko Dravic is the hub
cues.body: Ashvale Town keep finding Niko Dravic: he is on the end of 58% of their passes in the last 10 minutes.

cues.headline: Oren Isard scores!
cues.body: Get in! Harbor City 0–2 Ashvale Town. Against the run of play: Harbor City were in control.

cues.headline: Ashvale Town are on top
cues.body: Ashvale Town have taken over: they've had the ball 77% of the time in the last 5 minutes. Ashvale Town are already ahead, and still pushing.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 6.4 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: It's in! Emil Underhill!
cues.body: Emil Underhill finds the net for Harbor City: Harbor City 1–2 Ashvale Town. The broken game finally produced a goal. It came 5 seconds after Harbor City won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: GOAL! Fenn Valcourt!

cues.headline: Fenn Valcourt scores!
cues.body: Get in! Harbor City 3–2 Ashvale Town.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Harbor City 56%, Ashvale Town 44%. Neither team on top.

recap.headline: Full time: Harbor City 3–2 Ashvale Town
recap.summary: A deserved win for Harbor City.
